battle.name: 黃巢攻東都之戰
battle.brief: 唐僖宗中和元年（880）十一月，鹽梟出身的起義首領黃巢自曹州西進，連破洛陽、華州，兵鋒直逼長安（唐人稱東都），圍城歷一年有餘，終為沙陀騎兵與官軍在潼關擊破。卡面的羅馬弩砲並非唐代器械，它代表機械弩的技術譜系；唐代關中攻城靠拋石、床弩、雲梯與撞木，羅馬弩砲只是同類機器的古代代表。

kit.name: 羅馬弩砲
kit.history: 扭力弩砲，一發一具箭。羅馬用它拆掉希臘的城牆，也拆掉了希臘的城邦體系。

countries: 這場戰爭的交戰一方是唐僖宗的中和朝廷，另一方是黃巢的大齊軍。中和朝廷一方並非單一的中央直轄部隊，而是由數層軍事力量拼合而成：禁軍與神策軍由宦官田令孜掌握，是僖宗身邊唯一能隨意調動的武力；河中、昭義、忠武、邠寧、鎮海、關內等道的節度使各領本部兵馬，是勤王主力；唐廷又把希望押在歸附不久的沙陀騎兵上，李克用率沙陀眾自河中出發，成為解圍的關鍵。黃巢一方則是由王仙芝部眾、曹州起義的私鹽販與游眾、沿途歸附的州縣亂兵和降卒拼湊而成的流動軍團，以輕騎兵為骨幹，能在關中平原上快速縱掠，直到攻城時才把沿途繳獲的物資編成攻城車隊。第三方介入最深的是沙陀：唐廷以詔書招之，李克用便以勤王之名率部入關，卻在攻入長安之後很快把河東變成自己的地盤。戰區之內，關內各鎮彼此觀望，互援與拆台並存，勤王聯軍的指揮從未真正統一，這正是圍城能夠拖成兩年的結構性原因。
countriesEn: One side of this war was the Zhonghe court of Emperor Xianzong of Tang, the other the army of Huang Chao's Great Qi. The court side was not a single centrally controlled force but a patchwork of several layers of military power: the Imperial Guard and the Divine Might troops were held by the eunuch Tian Lingzi and were the only troops the emperor could move at will; the circuit governors of Hezhong, Zhaoyi, Zhongwu, Xinning, Zhenhai and Guannei each led their own contingents and formed the main body of the relief armies; and the court pinned its last hopes on the recently submitted Shatuo cavalry, for Li Keyong marched out of Hezhong with the Shatuo host and became the key to the relief. Huang Chao's side was a fluid host patched together from the remnants of Wang Xianzhi's army, the salt smugglers and stragglers who rose in Caozhou, the disorderly troops of counties that fell in along the way, and surrendered soldiers; its backbone was light cavalry able to sweep across the Guanzhong plain at speed, and only at the walls did it sort the loot gathered on the march into a siege train. The deepest third-party involvement came from the Shatuo: the court summoned them by edict, Li Keyong entered the passes in the name of relief, and soon after entering Chang'an turned Hedong into his own base. Within the theatre the circuits of Guannei watched one another, combining mutual support with mutual obstruction, and the relief coalition was never truly under one command; that is the structural reason the siege could be stretched out to two years.
people: 兩端的關鍵人物都在自己的位置上作出了關鍵決定。黃巢字巨真，出身曹州冤句，是往來各地販運私鹽的鹽梟，鹽法嚴苛之下鋌而走險；王仙芝起義之後他聚眾響應，被部眾推為首領，率這支流動的軍隊轉戰南北，兩年後自立為帝，國號大齊。僖宗出奔之後，他入據長安，改元金統。他的用兵性格決定了本役的樣子：重視速度與流動，把戰場當成可以整體搬移的獵場，一旦受挫便毫不戀戰地西走東竄，潼關失利後焚宮夜走，敗走蔡州，終於退到泰山狼虎谷，死於自己的部下之手。唐廷一方，僖宗李儇在兵鋒逼近時把政事交給宦官田令孜，自己倉皇西幸鳳翔、成都，數度靠勤王軍迎駕還京。真正改變戰局的是李克用，字鴉兒，出身河朔沙陀部，其父在唐軍中領沙陀渠帥，沙陀眾因受吐渾等部掠擾而歸唐，他自幼在亂世中以騎射立名，善使鐵槍。883 年初，他率沙陀騎兵自河中疾馳，於潼關大破巢軍，一戰扭轉關中局勢，事後被授河東節度使，開啟了河東軍鎮長期干政的序幕。此外，邠寧節度使朱玫與鎮海節度使王行瑜奉詔勤王、迎駕入京，其後彼此火併，朱玫兵敗被殺，說明勤王聯軍內部的裂痕。黃巢陣中則有尚讓、葛從周等分將兵權，尚讓日後反噬舊主，葛從周後來降唐。
peopleEn: The decisive men on both ends of this war made the decisions that mattered where they stood. Huang Chao, courtesy name Juzhen, was born in Yuanju of Caozhou and had been a salt smuggler carrying illegal salt between regions, driven to flight by the severity of the salt monopoly; when Wang Xianzhi rose he gathered men and answered the call, was pushed forward by his followers as leader, and led the fluid host around the north and south for two years before proclaiming himself emperor of Great Qi. After Xianzong fled he took up residence in Chang'an and changed the era to Jintong. His habits as a commander determined the character of this campaign: he valued speed and movement, treated the battlefield as hunting ground that could be shifted bodily, and when checked turned away without clinging to the ground, burning the palace and leaving by night after the defeat at Tongguan, falling back on Caizhou and finally perishing at Langhugu in Mount Tai at the hands of his own men. On the court side, Emperor Xianzong, Li Xuan, handed affairs to the eunuch Tian Lingzi as the enemy approached and fled west to Fengxiang and then Chengdu, returning to the capital more than once in the escort of relief armies. The man who truly changed the course was Li Keyong, courtesy name Ya'er, of the Shatuo of northern Hebei; his father led the Shatuo as a tribal commander in Tang service, the Shatuo had submitted after being raided by the Tuhun and other peoples, and from childhood he made his name in a disorderly age on horseback and with the iron lance. In early 883 he led Shatuo cavalry racing from Hezhong and broke Huang Chao's army at Tongguan, turning the situation in Guanzhong in a single stroke, and was afterwards made military governor of Hedong, opening the long era in which the Hedong army intervened in the succession of Tang. Others include Zhu Mei, circuit governor of Xinning, and Wang Xingyu, circuit governor of Zhenhai, who came by edict to relieve the throne and escort the emperor back to the capital, then fell out and fought among themselves, with Zhu Mei defeated and killed, showing the fissures inside the relief coalition. On Huang Chao's side were men such as Shang Rang and Ge Congzhou holding separate commands; Shang Rang later turned on his old master, and Ge Congzhou eventually surrendered to Tang.
kits: 卡面這具羅馬弩砲（Scorpio）是公元前五十年前後羅馬軍的制式火器：木製框架張以扭簧儲力，一發一矢，弩矢以公尺計、每具重可數十公斤，兩三人操作的機位可在一分鐘內發射上百發，有效射程在三百公尺以上。羅馬人把它用於野戰中壓制遠距目標，也用於攻城時封住城頭的射界，卡面所說「用它拆掉希臘的城牆」正是這層用法。放到唐代的關中，這具機器並不在場。八百八十年前後的唐朝攻城，實際動用的是三類器材：一是拋石，唐人稱「砲」，以木臂或配重把石彈拋向城頭、砸向城牆，這是攻破城防的主力；二是弩機，安在床架上的大型弩車與小床弩，以絞盤張弦，射程遠而射速慢；三是雲梯、巢車與撞木這類近身器材，供步兵攀城與破門。守方則以弓弩、礪石、檑木與飛火應對。相比之下，羅馬弩砲那種以扭簧儲能、單發重箭、可連續快速發射的機械弩，在中國並沒有相應的實物技術路徑，兩者只是同屬「機械弩」這一門類。卡面用羅馬弩砲代表這門類在羅馬體系裡最成熟的形態，用以標明本役攻城雙方的火力配置：一方靠拋石砸、一方靠弩射，羅馬式的單發扭力火器則留在技術譜系的位置上。運輸與畜力方面，唐軍把糧食、箭矢與攻城構件自河中、華州沿官道運入關中，牛車與騾隊是主要載具；黃巢軍以輕騎為主，攻城器材多靠沿途繳獲與徵用，騎兵同時負責切斷東面的糧運；沙陀騎兵靠馬匹自河中直驅潼關，輕裝急行，抵達即投入戰鬥。
kitsEn: The Roman bolt-thrower on the card (Scorpio) was standard artillery in the Roman army around 50 BC: a wooden frame wound with torsion springs that stored the energy, one heavy bolt to a shot, the bolts measured in metres and weighing tens of kilograms, the piece served by two or three men and able to fire more than a hundred shots a minute with an effective range above three hundred metres. The Romans used it both to bear down on distant targets in the field and to seal the firing positions on a wall during a siege, and the card's remark that it was used to break down the walls of Greek cities points exactly at that use. Set in Guanzhong in the Tang, this machine was not present. The Tang siegecraft of the years around 880 actually worked with three kinds of equipment. First, thrown stone: the Tang called it the po, a stone-thrower using a timber arm or a counterweight to lob a stone ball at the wall-head or against the wall, and this was the main means of breaking defences. Second, bolt-throwers: large crossbow engines mounted on bed frames and smaller bed crossbows, drawn by windlass, long-ranged but slow in rate of fire. Third, the close-range gear of scaling ladders, siege towers and battering rams, for infantry to climb and for gates to be broken. The defenders answered with bows and crossbows, stone missiles, dropped logs and fire-pots. The Roman engine's way of storing power in torsion springs, firing a single heavy bolt and repeating quickly, had no corresponding physical technological line in China; the two belong to the same category of mechanical crossbow and no more. The card uses the Roman ballista to represent the most developed form of that category in the Roman system, and thereby to mark the configuration of firepower on both sides in this campaign: one side smashed with thrown stone, the other shot with crossbows, while the Roman single-shot torsion piece stayed at the level of technological pedigree. For transport and motive power, the Tang brought grain, arrows and siege timbers in from Hezhong and Huazhou along the imperial roads, with ox carts and mule teams as the main carriers; Huang Chao's host was light cavalry first, its siege gear mostly taken by capture and requisition on the march, and the same horsemen cut the grain route from the east; the Shatuo cavalry rode straight from Hezhong to Tongguan, travelling light and in haste, and went straight into the fight on arrival.
tactics: 本役的戰法可分三段。黃巢西進一段以流動打擊為主：起義軍不與唐軍主力正面對撞，而是以輕騎兵縱掠關中平原，逐次攻取無兵防守的州縣，切斷從東面來的糧道，再用迂迴與突襲逼近長安；這一路最重的一手是奪關，華州與潼關是關中的門戶，一旦拿下，城中的守軍與朝中各方都失去屏障。圍城一段，黃巢把騎兵散出去掠地與斷援，攻城器械則集中使用：在華州與長安城下的攻勢中，拋石反覆投向城牆與城頭，雲梯與巢車靠上去時，步兵以弓弩掩護，試圖在城頭的射界上撕開缺口；守方以城頭弩機、礪石、檑木與飛火回應，屢次打退攀城者。起義軍的攻城依靠的是人數與器械的堆疊，而不是任何單件武器的技術奇襲。解圍與反攻一段是本役的轉折。潼關是關中的咽喉，關道狹窄，利於據守而不利於展開；朝廷的勤王聯軍在此集結，883 年初李克用率沙陀騎兵自河中疾馳而來，傳記說這支騎兵多著黑衣，號為「鴉軍」，在夜色中自山谷驟然馳出，直插黃巢軍的側背，巢軍大敗，聯軍乘勝進逼長安。黃巢焚毀宮室、掠盡府庫而走，保據蔡州。整場戰役的勝負，實際上取決於一條峽道裡幾千騎兵與數十萬大軍之間的對比。
tacticsEn: The method of this campaign had three movements. In the first, Huang Chao's advance westward, the rebel host avoided engaging the Tang field army head-on: light cavalry swept across the Guanzhong plain, taking in turn those prefectures and counties that had no troops to hold them, cutting the grain route coming from the east, and closing on Chang'an by turning movements and sudden attacks. The weightiest stroke of this phase was the taking of the passes, for Huazhou and Tongguan were the gates of Guanzhong, and once they fell the garrison inside the city and every faction at court lost their screen. In the second movement, the siege, Huang Chao scattered his horsemen to forage and to cut off relief, while concentrating the siege equipment: before Huazhou and before the walls of Chang'an the thrown stones were repeatedly directed at the wall and the wall-head, and when the scaling ladders and siege towers came up the infantry covered them with bows and crossbows, trying to tear a gap in the firing lanes of the defenders; the defenders replied with wall-mounted crossbow engines, stone missiles, dropped logs and fire-pots, and beat back the climbers time after time. The rebel assault rested on the piling up of numbers and machines, not on any technical surprise by a single weapon. The third movement, the relief and the counterstroke, was the turn of the campaign. Tongguan was the throat of Guanzhong, its defile narrow, favourable to defence and unfavourable to deployment; the court's relief coalition assembled there, and in early 883 Li Keyong brought the Shatuo cavalry racing from Hezhong, a force that according to the accounts was clothed in black and called the Crow Army, bursting out of the valley by night and striking the flank and rear of Huang Chao's army, which broke; the coalition pressed on to Chang'an, and Huang Chao burned the palace, emptied the treasuries and left, holding on at Caizhou. In the end the outcome of the whole campaign turned on the contrast between a few thousand horsemen in a defile and an army numbered in tens of thousands.
data: 可核對的數字大致如下。時序上，王仙芝於廣明元年（875）在河南起義，兩年之後敗死，部眾多歸黃巢；黃巢於八七七至八七八年間在曹州聚眾，兩年後自立為齊帝。中和元年（880）十一月，起義軍西進，洛陽城破，河南尹羅嗣英殉城；其後兵鋒指向華州與潼關，八百八十一年冬黃巢入長安，改元金統，僖宗已先後西幸鳳翔、成都。八百八十三年正月初，潼關之戰，巢軍大敗，退保蔡州；同年十二月僖宗還京；八百八十四年六月至七月，黃巢敗走泰山狼虎谷，為部下所殺，諸子亦死。地理量度上，京洛至長安的道路約七百餘里，潼關至長安約二百餘里；沙陀騎兵自河中出發，數日而抵潼關，關中各道的勤王師則由同州、河中一線分道入關。兵力方面，黃巢軍在鼎盛時諸史所記從數萬到數十萬不等，甚至有「百萬」之辭，實數當遠少於此；沙陀騎兵通稱數千，具體人數諸說紛紜；勤王聯軍來自十數道，總數無可考的實數，記載常以「百萬」「大軍」一類籠統辭語帶過。糧秣方面，官軍糧道自河中、同州入關，道路屢遭騎兵切斷，圍城之際軍中乏食、有殺馬以食之說，但確數不傳。攻城器材的數目、雙方陣亡與俘虜的總數，史無明文，不宜當作數據使用。
dataEn: The figures that can be checked are roughly these. In chronology: Wang Xianzhi rose in Henan in 875, the first year of Guangming, and was defeated and killed two years later, most of his followers going over to Huang Chao; Huang Chao gathered men at Caozhou between 877 and 878 and two years after that proclaimed himself emperor of Qi. In the eleventh month of 880, the first year of Zhonghe, the rebel host moved west, Luoyang fell and the governor of Henan, Luo Siying, died in the city; the advance then pointed at Huazhou and Tongguan, and in the winter of 881 Huang Chao entered Chang'an and changed the era to Jintong, the emperor having already fled west in turn to Fengxiang and Chengdu. In the first month of 883 the battle of Tongguan was fought, the rebel army was broken and fell back on Caizhou; in the twelfth month of the same year the emperor returned to the capital; between the sixth and seventh months of 884 Huang Chao was driven to Langhugu in Mount Tai and killed by his own men, and his sons died with the cause. In geography: the road from the eastern capital to Chang'an ran about seven hundred li, and Tongguan lay a little over two hundred li from Chang'an; the Shatuo cavalry set out from Hezhong and reached Tongguan in a matter of days, while the relief troops of the various circuits entered the pass by the routes through Tongzhou and Hezhong. In strength: at its height the rebel host is given in the histories as running from tens of thousands to hundreds of thousands, with even a claim of a million, and the real figure must have been far lower; the Shatuo cavalry are commonly given as several thousand, with the exact number given variously; the relief coalition drew from a dozen circuits and no checkable total exists, the records using blanket phrases such as a hundred thousand or a great army. On supply: the grain route for the imperial troops ran in from Hezhong and Tongzhou and was repeatedly cut by horsemen, and there is a saying that food ran short in the camp during the siege and horses were killed for meat, but no figures survive. The number of siege engines and the totals of dead and prisoners on both sides are simply not recorded, and should not be used as data.
cause: 開戰的動因，是中晚唐的藩鎮割據、嚴酷的鹽法與河南一帶的災荒三者疊加。僖宗即位之後一心削藩，屢次以罷免、分割與改置將吏的辦法逼反擁兵自重的方鎮，河東、河中一帶的軍府因此屢生變亂，朝廷每平一次叛亂，就再把兵權交到另一批節度使手裡，兵越多而中央越空。與此同時，廣明以來河南、山南一帶連歲不登，糧價騰貴，私鹽販運的隊伍在嚴苛的鹽法之下越積越大，王仙芝在河南揭竿，黃巢隨即以曹州為基地響應，兩支部眾最後合流，規模由數萬膨脹到數十萬。朝廷倚靠的地方軍鎮各自保存實力，出兵時互相觀望，遇到硬仗便不肯用命，勤王之師雖多而不能合戰。關中更是一片空虛：長期徵發之後倉儲已盡，潼關、華州一線的守軍單薄，潼關城外的道路又早被起義軍的輕騎控制，東面運來的糧隊在途中被吃掉一部分。宦官田令孜掌管禁軍與神策軍，斂財自肥，軍需器械的供應並不充裕。凡此種種，使本役在開打之前就已經注定：起義軍只需要走到城門下，而唐廷必須讓敵人騎兵無法馳騁於關中平原。
causeEn: What set this war going was the combination in the middle and late Tang of military commandery separatism, a harsh salt monopoly, and famine in the region around Henan. After his accession Xianzong made reduction of the circuits his single policy, and repeatedly sought to bring the self-governing governors to heel by dismissal, partition and substitution; the commands around Hedong and Hezhong revolted again and again in consequence, and every time the court suppressed a rising it handed the troops to a new set of governors, so that the number of soldiers grew while the centre grew emptier. At the same time, from the Guangming era onward Henan and Shannan went without harvests year after year and grain prices soared, and the gangs that carried illegal salt grew larger and larger under the severity of the salt regulations; Wang Xianzhi raised the standard in Henan, Huang Chao answered from Caozhou, and the two hosts eventually merged, growing from some thousands to tens of thousands. The local commanderies the court relied on each preserved their own strength, watched one another when they marched out, and would not spend their lives in a hard fight, so the relief armies were many but could not be brought to a single battle. Guanzhong itself was hollow: after long requisitions the granaries were empty, the garrisons on the line of Tongguan and Huazhou were thin, and the roads west of Tongguan had long been in the hands of the rebel light cavalry, which ate part of the grain trains coming from the east. The eunuch Tian Lingzi held the Imperial Guard and the Divine Might troops and grew rich in the process, and the supply of arms and equipment was not generous. All of this meant the outcome was settled before the first blow: the rebel host only had to reach the walls, while the Tang had to keep enemy horsemen from riding free across the Guanzhong plain.
impact: 黃巢入據長安的兩年，對唐廷的傷害不在一場會戰，而在信用與秩序的崩解。宮室為亂軍所焚，府庫為亂軍所掠，僖宗兩度出奔、四處求援，朝廷在方鎮面前再無威嚴可言。此役最深遠的影響在軍制層面：唐廷平亂倚賴沙陀騎兵，李克用因此得以坐大河東，率軍鎮之力問鼎中央，朝廷為制衡藩鎮，反而不斷倚重這支客軍。河東軍鎮自此成為晚唐五代最重要的政治變數，歷經李克用、李存勖兩代，最終取代朱溫建立的後梁而另立後唐，904 年入洛陽、923 年滅晉，其後的宋、遼都建立在那樣的格局之上。另一條線是降將：巢軍失敗之後，朱溫、秦宗權等人以討巢的名義各據一方，把原本的亂軍收編為自己的部曲，唐廷雖平了叛亂，卻等於替藩鎮清除了障礙。908 年朱溫代唐，終結了二百八十九年的唐朝，五代的亂局由此開端。總括而言，黃巢攻東都之戰既是唐廷的一次慘敗，也是唐朝覆亡的起點：這場戰爭證明，中央在失去方鎮的同時，又把救命的倚賴交給了另一個方鎮。
impactEn: The two years Huang Chao held Chang'an did Tang no harm in any single battle; the damage was to credit and order. The palace was burned by the rebel host and the treasuries emptied; the emperor fled west twice and went about the country begging for help, and before the commanderies the court had no authority left to speak of. The deepest effect of the campaign lay in the military system. The court put the war down to the Shatuo cavalry, and Li Keyong grew in Hedong on the strength of it, bringing the weight of a circuit army to bear on the centre; and because the court needed a counterweight to the separatist governors, it kept leaning on that foreign army ever more. The Hedong command became from then on the most important political variable of the late Tang and the Five Dynasties; through two generations, Li Keyong and Li Cunxu, it finally replaced the Later Liang of Zhu Wen and founded the Later Tang, entering Luoyang in 904 and extinguishing Jin in 923, and the Song and Liao that came later were all built on a settlement of that kind. A second line was the surrendered commanders: after the rebel host was beaten, men such as Zhu Wen and Qin Zongquan took up the cause of fighting Huang Chao as a pretext and each held a region of their own, folding the disorderly troops of the rebellion into their private forces. In defeating the rising the court had cleared the ground for the circuits instead, and in 908 Zhu Wen took the throne from the Tang and ended a dynasty of two hundred and eighty-nine years, opening the disorder of the Five Dynasties. In sum, the battle for the Eastern Capital was both a defeat for the Tang and the beginning of its end: it showed that at the very moment the centre lost its governors, it handed the decisive dependence of its survival to another governor.
result: 結果是起義軍的失敗，與唐廷秩序的恢復。八百八十三年正月初，潼關一戰，巢軍側背受敵，全軍崩潰，黃巢焚毀宮室、掠盡府庫，率部東走，保據蔡州；其後轉戰於泰山狼虎谷，八百八十四年六月至七月兵敗，為自己部將所殺，諸子相繼死於亂軍，餘眾或降或散，鑄造了大齊的號令自此終結。同年十二月，僖宗還都長安，收復宮室，重建朝廷典禮。但勝利屬於朝廷的失敗屬於朝廷自己：平叛的大軍是河東沙陀，勤王的名將成了新的藩鎮主人，被平掉的叛軍成了方鎮的私兵，關中被掠空的府庫與燒毀的宮殿一時無力恢復。黃巢之亂在史冊上因此是一場清楚的敗仗，而在制度的層面，它替唐的滅亡清出了道路：此後藩鎮愈演愈烈，宦官與朝臣爭鬥不息，到九〇七年朱溫迫僖宗禪位，唐朝四百九十年的祚運告終，歷史進入五代十國的分裂時代。
resultEn: The result was the failure of the rebel host, and a recovery of Tang order that was not really a recovery. In the first month of 883 the battle of Tongguan turned on Huang Chao's flank, the whole army collapsed, and Huang Chao burned the palace, emptied the treasuries and withdrew eastward to hold at Caizhou; after further fighting at Langhugu in Mount Tai, defeated in the sixth and seventh months of 884, he was killed by his own commander, his sons died with the cause in the disorder, and the surviving men either surrendered or scattered, and the Great Qi proclaimed at Chaozhou was thereby ended. In the twelfth month of the same year the emperor returned to the capital at Chang'an, took possession of the palace and restored the ceremonies of the court. But the victory belonged to the court and the defeat also belonged to the court: the army that had settled the rising was the Shatuo of Hedong, the famous saviour of the throne became the master of a new circuit, and the rebels who had been destroyed were turned into the private soldiers of the governors, while the treasuries of Guanzhong, emptied by plunder, and the palace halls, burned down, could not be restored in a moment. In the annals the rebellion of Huang Chao is therefore an unambiguous defeat; at the level of institutions it cleared the road to the end of the dynasty. From then on the circuits grew ever more powerful, the eunuchs and the ministers of state fought each other without pause, and in 907 Zhu Wen forced Xianzong to abdicate, ending the Tang after four hundred and ninety years and carrying Chinese history into the divided age of the Five Dynasties and the Ten Kingdoms.
